The **Demographic** topic in this corpus centers on surgical patient statistics, specifically highlighting procedural volumes and age distributions for patients in [[danmark|Danmark]]. Currently, the evidence base for this topic is limited to a single reporting period, providing a focused snapshot of surgical demographics without broader regional comparisons or detailed subgroup breakdowns.

For the timeframe spanning September 1, 2022, to August 31, 2023, demographic records indicate that a total of 3,745 patients were operated on in [[danmark|Danmark]] [^src1]. The age profile of this surgical cohort shows a median age of 70.00 years, alongside an average (mean) age of 65.46 years [^src1]. Because the dataset contains only this single claim regarding surgical demographics, no further details regarding specific procedure types, gender distributions, or additional entity connections are available in the current text.

## Claims

- For Danmark i perioden 01/09/2022 – 31/08/2023 var antallet af opererede 3.745, medianalderen 70,00 år og gennemsnitsalderen 65,46 år [^src1] (danmark)
